protocol.purpose: CPU research baseline and quantization-abstention experiment; not a claim of journal or competition readiness.
protocol.legacyEvidence: C-profile test and CNN pilot have already been viewed. Do not use them for this design, selection or evaluation.

development.source: Only these seven original recordings may be loaded by development stage.

holdout.access: Only download/prepare after source hashes, all candidate models, thresholds and development-selected model have been frozen.

protocol.preprocessing: Identical 200kHz -> 4kHz 1001-tap Blackman 1.2kHz low-pass, factor50, 512-sample windows, 78 per recording. No encoder/label/file metadata as features. No post-test changes.

features.shape: Mean-centered, RMS-normalized 512-point Hann FFT; 16 relative-power bands over positive-frequency bins1..256 with dimensionless 1e-12 pseudocount, log ratios; log kurtosis, log crest factor and zero-crossing rate (19 features).
features.hybrid: The 19 shape features plus log(raw centered RMS); tests whether amplitude adds value at the cost of gain sensitivity.
features.scaling: Fit-normal feature median and 1.4826*MAD, with 0.05 dimensionless floor; no arbitrary raw-amplitude floor.
features.coreset: Deterministic farthest-first coverage in standardized feature space, starting nearest to the fit center. All fit groups equally represented in input; no anomaly labels used.
features.silence: RMS below 1e-12 is an invalid sensor window, not a normal decision.

protocol.calibration: For ALL candidates use maximum of the two per-normal-recording nearest-rank 95th-percentile scores. Same explicit heuristic; no conformal or 5% generalization guarantee from two groups. INT8 uses the matched Float64 model's frozen threshold.
protocol.quantization: Per-feature signed INT8 reference coordinates, Float64 scale and per-reference reconstruction radius. Query remains Float64; no query clipping. Use triangle-inequality distance interval: decisive only if the whole interval lies on one side of threshold; otherwise abstain. No exact bank at INT8 inference; matching reference available in separate evaluation worker only.

stress.meaning: Paired artificial perturbations of each held-out recording, NOT new independent real recordings or new real faults. Gaussian noise has nominal expected SNR20dB (finite-window realized SNR varies), deterministic per recording/window. Fit/calibration not perturbed.

metrics.quality: Per-recording TP/FP/TN/FN plus separate positive/negative abstentions; coverage; recall bounds treating abstentions as misses/hits; FPR bounds; decided-only quality labeled conditional.
metrics.auc: Rank score AUROC on all windows, including abstentions, with explicit small-sample/dependence warning.
metrics.uncertainty: No window-IID confidence interval, bootstrap p-value or statistical significance claim with only one recording per health condition.
metrics.baselineSelection: On unmodified development A3 only: require <=10% normal FPR upper bound, >=90% decision coverage, <=32KiB accounted numeric working buffers, <=256MiB observed worker RSS, <=5ms p95. Rank by worst-case F1 counting normal abstentions as FP and anomalous abstentions as FN; ties choose smaller numeric working set. Select NONE if no candidate passes. Never reselect on D.
metrics.acceptance: The fresh D result is reported even if it invalidates the contribution hypothesis; no tuning/retest iteration on D.

timing.scope: JSON parse -> input validation -> feature extraction -> score interval/decision -> JSON serialize; excludes offline preprocessing, transport and renderer.
timing.memory: Model typed arrays + one input + worst-case live numeric scratch; distinguish bank-only and total. Worker OS lifetime maxRSS reported separately. Quantized deployment worker never loads Float64 model.
timing.execution: Sequential fresh Node workers, single-threaded V8, UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE=1; no CNN retraining or GPU.

lock.note: Local hash/timestamp lock, not a third-party preregistration or tamper-proof attestation. No post-holdout model edits permitted in this protocol.
